summary: This configuration section tells Black, a Python code formatter, to format code with a maximum line length of 120 characters and to use Python 3.13 syntax rules. Black is a tool that automatically reformats Python code to follow consistent style rules across a project.

explanations.4: line-length = 120 means Black will try to keep lines of code at or below 120 characters wide before wrapping them to the next line.
explanations.8: target-version = ['py313'] tells Black to format the code using Python 3.13 syntax and features; you can include multiple versions in the list if you need to support older Python versions too.
